test_throw_on_failure_mode: test the throw-on-failure mode with environment variables and command line flags
run_gtest_subprocess: run a gtest subprocess command and return True if exit code is zero
set_environment_variable: set or unset an environment variable for Google Test throw-on-failure mode
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_throw_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_THROW_ON_FAILURE environment variable
verify_default_behavior: verify the default throw-on-failure behavior when no environment variable or flag is set
